title: Die periodische Gesetzmässigkeit der chemischen Elemente, in an 1895 collected reprint
version: Leipzig, 1895; Seubert’s German reprint of Wreden’s translation; public-domain scan
lineage: A later reprint of the German translation, not an independently inspected 1871 Russian original. The reprint attributes the original article to 1871; other historians cite its German issue as 1872. The predictions are represented as historical, not universally correct.

passages.note: Reprint title page and printed pp. 94–96 / source PDF pp. 97–99: the eka-aluminium and eka-silicon predictions; p. 95 gives approximately 68 and 6.0 for the former.

file.method: Selected pages extracted without changing page content using pdfseparate/pdfunite; corresponding raster renders checked against the complete source. Source-page numbering counts the original PDF from one.
